sections.heading: Intro
sections.content_markdown:
These rules always apply, regardless of goal or phase.
Volume system: MEV → MAV → MRV per mesocycle
Flow principle: 20–30 sec rest between exercises in superset · maintain HR 115–125 bpm
Technique over load always
End-range strength must be integrated
Mobility is a primary domain, not optional
Conditioning max 3x per week
Separate heavy strength and HIIT by at least 6 hours
Zone 2 before hypertrophy only under HR threshold

sections.heading: Conditioning Protocol (three modalities)
sections.content_markdown:
| Modality | Frequency | Duration | Intensity |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Zone 2 | 2x/week | 45 min | HR 115–125 bpm |
| Tempo | 1x/week | 25 min | ~80% HRmax |
| HIIT | 1x/week | 5x2 min work + 2 min rest | 85–90% HRmax |
Rules:
Always post-strength or on separate days
Total conditioning sessions ≤3/week
HR drift <5% in Zone 2 = aerobic adaptation success
HIIT only when fresh — never stacked on heavy strength day

sections.heading: Safety (Priority 1)
sections.content_markdown:
No high-skill movements under fatigue
No high-volume strength + heavy conditioning in same session unless doctrine-approved
Fatigue markers govern intensity
Pain = modify (replace movement, same pattern, pain-free)
Technique and ROM > Load
